name: kinetic-warp
title: Kinetic Warp
description: A coarse mesh warp bends a whole word in staccato beats, one axis moving per keyframe.
useWhen: A short, heavy display word needs a bold kinetic moment where the whole word bends and snaps instead of individual letters animating.
A rhythmic, beat-synced distortion: the mesh stops dead at every keyframe, so each pose lands like a drum hit.
avoidWhen: You need a text entrance: the word is fully visible from frame 0 and only distorts. Use tracking-in or soft-blur-in.
The text is long or small: the mesh bends quarters of the frame, so use per-character-rise.
author: Remocn
